method_disposition.current_rear_application: A conditional sensitivity only: preserve the V1 current-force reconstruction and Fe/5 threshold, use Mp/4 for the common shaft hinge reference, and retain the independent Fy/2 metal threshold unchanged. The Fe/5 radial flags identify exceedance of this one affine statically equivalent pressure field; they do not prove every compatible bounded bearing distribution fails. No whole-joint Cg/Cdelta or splitting conclusion follows.
method_disposition.generic_45ksi: Shown only as a separate sensitivity and not merged with the conditional Grade5/F606 92 ksi basis.
method_disposition.historical_control_reproduction_note: The frozen calibration producer is source-bound but its current source text uses a fixed angle_max_degrees=90 while the frozen JSON standard capacities reproduce exactly with angle_max_degrees equal to each row theta. This additive control replay follows the frozen JSON values and confirms them using the pinned NDS helper at the row theta; it does not rewrite the historic producer or JSON.
method_disposition.modewise_result: For the pinned NDS Table 12.3.1B branch with D>=1/4 in and theta<=90 degrees, Fe/5 is no greater than the NDS bearing input Fe/Rd for Im, Is, II, IIIm, IIIs, or IV. For hinge modes III/IV, Mp/4 is no greater than the corresponding NDS hinge input Mp/Rd. Thus this separately declared material-input envelope is modewise conservative for the matched single-shear EYM work calculation; the saved positive-work argument and these 18 controls support that narrow result.
method_disposition.positive_work_reasoning: At a fixed mechanism/geometry, the EYM virtual-work resistance is nondecreasing and positively homogeneous in the bearing and plastic-hinge resistance inputs. Each mode therefore cannot exceed its NDS-adjusted mode when every participating resistance input is reduced to no more than its corresponding NDS value; taking the minimum over modes preserves the upper comparison. This is a material-yield/EYM statement, not proof that the current 1D radial/hinge field is a code-tabulated NDS connection or physically compatible.

scope: Four unchanged rear shafts, six admitted cases, full signed receiver wrenches and continuous body/root cuts. Separate conditional material references, not complete connection capacity.
scope_limits: No geometry, force field, receiver reconstruction, or original /5 result is changed.
This is not a new universal Cg, NDS capacity factor, complete connection rating, or physical contact/compatibility proof.
Axial, shear, torsion, washer/nut seat, wood splitting, spacing/end/edge, group distribution and fit remain separate or unresolved; the report's independent Fy/2 result remains unchanged.
Conditional 92 ksi values are property-input scenarios; delivered fastener conformance and actual Fyb/Fy remain unobserved.
Eight Fe/5 flags describe one chosen affine radial-pressure construction. They are not a proof that every admissible bearing distribution or the physical joint fails.
The original uniform /5 reference and all historical diagnostics remain unchanged. A /4 hinge sensitivity is not an adopted whole-joint NDS, group or independent-steel factor.

Fe_over_5_affine_static_field_flags.interpretation: These are exceedances of the one selected affine statically equivalent radial-pressure field reference. They do not prove that every compatible or physically bounded bearing distribution fails.

source_boolean_label_note: The raw sensitivity's divisor-no-larger labels are not copied: the correct comparison is reduced inputs Fe/5 <= Fe/Rd and Mp/4 <= Mp/Rd, hence divisors >= the applicable Rd. The numeric source values and all results are preserved.
